title: Your palette is waiting on you

beats.say: Quick one. The suite's colour palette is stuck on a single decision, and it's yours.
Round one spaced its hues evenly around the colour wheel. That's Tailwind's recipe, so it looked like everyone else's.
So the new board has three directions, each seeded from something real: apothecary glass, prairie light, and a synth panel.
Every hue was checked against nine hundred and eighty-six stock colours. Five strong reds and blues are still close, and they're flagged.
Your move: open the board, pick a direction, tap about seven hues, and paste your picks into the palette thread.
Once you pick, every app pulls its colours from that one palette. This reel included. No more stock look.
